newsitem.title: ISRAEL: U.S. envoy cautious on sealing Hebron deal today.
newsitem.headline: U.S. envoy cautious on sealing Hebron deal today.

text.p: U.S. peace envoy Dennis Ross, arriving on Tuesday for a meeting between Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, said more sessions might be needed to clinch an accord on a long-overdue Israeli troop pullback from Hebron.

"We have clearly energised negotiations over the last couple of days," Ross told reporters, in a reference to his mediation shuttle that began late on Saturday. But he added: "I wouldn't expect necessarily that one meeting is going to conclude it at this stage."
